text.what: The workhorse of American pinot noir before the Dijon numbers arrived, and still planted everywhere. Bigger berries, firmer structure, a darker wine than the Dijons give.
text.how: Held and distributed through UC Davis, which is where the number comes from. Oregon built its early reputation on this and on Wädenswil.

kin.as: The other half of Oregon's old plantings.
What arrived later and changed the arithmetic.
Why a vine has a catalogue number at all.
